title: LighterUtility
description: A collection of changes to Minecraft mostly for SMP. Suggestions welcome!
body:
# LighterUtility 🪶
An assorement of configurable changes to tailor your surivival multiplayer server to your liking. There are configurable options such as maximum repair cost for anvils, no enderman griefing, crop protection, and more to possibly come.

This plugin is intended to be lightweight and simple to be able to drag and drop into any of your favorite servers without having to read a wall of text of documentation to set up!

# Setup 🛠️
All configuration is optional and most tweaks are enabled by default. All tweaks can be found in `/plugins/LighterUtility/config.yml`.

# Suggestions 📜
This plugin is open to suggestions for more changes or features to change how survival is played. All suggestions can be made on [GitHub](https://github.com/gabehxd/LighterUtility/issues).
